Interview: Sector Commander Shafiullah
2014-12-03T19:00:54+06:00 | Zaid Kalam
https://www.thedailystar.net/sector-commander-shafiullah-part-1-54667

Major General (retd) KM Shafiullah was the Second in Command of Seceond East Bengal Regiment that revolted on the night of March 25, 1971. He talks about the contribution of the armed forces to our Liberation War. Also watch Part 2

This interview was first published on our Freedom in the Air repository in November 23, 2014.
